title: Men at Outdoor Table with Morton Salt, 1966 Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A mid-1960s vintage Polaroid snapshot taken on July 26, 1966, depicting two men working outdoors at a wooden bench in a wooded setting. One man wears a plaid shirt and hat while standing near boxes of Morton Salt, as another man pours liquid from a container. The image captures a quintessential slice of mid-century American outdoor recreation and everyday leisure.
